text.p: Following is a list of appearances before parliamentary committees this week:
MONDAY, Dec 2
- Plenary meeting on draft bill on corporate documentation
- Meeting to dissuss draft bill on psychotropic drugs
(meeting all week).
- Meeting to discuss draft bill on disabled people (meeting
all week)
TUESDAY Dec 3
- Commission III - visit Cipinang prison
- Commission V - meeting director generals of land, sea and
air transport from Transport Ministry
- Comission VII - visit to Customs office
- Comission IX - meeting with Education and Culture Minister
- Commission X - meeting with hospital officials
- Budget Commission - visit to the government's Audit agency
WEDNESDAY, Dec 4
- Commission I - meeting with journalists association (PWI)
- Commission IV - visit to Sukabumi and Cianjur
national reserve parks in West Java
- Commission V - meeting with Director General of Posts.
- Commission VI - meeting with retailers
- Commission VII - meeting with Cooperatives Minister
- Commission X - meeting with ceramics manufacturer PT KIA
THURSDAY, Dec 5
- Commission I - meeting with Foreign Minister
- Commission II - meeting with Kerawang regent, West Java.
- Commission III - meeting with Attorney General.
- Commission IV - meeting with state-owned timber firms
Inhutani IV and Inhutani V
- Commission V - meeting with port operator PT Pelindo
- Commission VII - meeting with Food Minister
- Commission IX - meeting with Sports and Youth Affairs
Minister.
- Commission X - meeting with West Java Governor and Director
General of Mining
FRIDAY, Dec 6
- Commission V meeting with Director General of Irrigation
